_status: TO BE VERIFIED BY A LICENSED ENGINEER. A first check of how evenly the load-bearing walls are spread, not a structural calculation.
_doc: The check follows the regularity criterion of Eurocode 8 (EN 1998-1, 4.2.3.2 (6)): in each direction the distance between the centre of mass and the centre of stiffness (the eccentricity) must be at most maxEccentricityRatio times the torsional radius, and when checkGyration is true the torsional radius must be at least the radius of gyration of the floor. Each wall stands for a cantilever whose stiffness is taken as its second moment of area (thickness x length^3 / 12 along the wall); doors and windows cut a wall into separate piers. The outside walls, the core walls, the walls marked load-bearing and the columns count. The mass is taken as spread evenly over the floor outline.
